description: This PHP source file defines the AccessTokenRepository class responsible for managing OAuth2 access tokens, including creation, persistence, revocation, and revocation status checks in a CRM system.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 access token management functionalities such as creation, persistence, revocation, and status checking according to the OAuth2 specification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AccessTokenEntity and BeanManager instances.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AccessTokenEntity configured with client, scopes, and user identifier.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Persists a new access token to storage, associating it with a client and user, and ensuring the user is valid and enabled.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Revokes (deletes) an existing access token identified by its token ID.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a specified access token has been revoked or expired.
